The '''battle stimulant''' was a [[Stimulant/Legends|stim]] that enabled the user to better absorb damage and allowed the mind to focus more on the fight. This resulted in an increased ability to hit the opponent. The side effects were minimal and the effect would wear off after a short period of [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
